changes: main.py: installation.json next to the entry supplies the installation root, output root, HOME and Python pin; the policy is schema v2; the gate review and the entry review are pin data in the policy, so no receipt is read at run time; the E3 rule compares the entry review data with this entry's six source pins and the policy without the review slot; the inventory children check tree manifests instead of the dependency baseline

check.py: the installation record (path and pin) replaces the gate and helper receipts; the compiler reads the installed lean-v8 objects and the helper objects through the recorded `lake env` search path instead of copies in the run; search-path containment and the sysroot check use the installed project and toolchain; HOME, the toolchain and the output root come from the record; the per-phase guards, generation, audits, endpoint and archive are unchanged
invoke.py: the inventory mode runs trees.py verify; the check mode no longer sets gate or baseline paths
trees.py (new): records at install and verifies before and after each run the SHA-256 of every file in the toolchain, every directory on the recorded LEAN_PATH and the helper objects
provision-policy.py: pins sources relative to the installation root; machine-specific values go to installation.json

Shipping layout (2026-10-26): the entry, generator, recipe and helper sources moved to tools/v8_kernel/; pins/moved-files.json maps every file to its development or receipt copy. Byte-identical except check.py (the two recipe directory constants) and provision-policy.py (the layout constants and the repository root).
